metricText: BEA U.S. International Transactions Table 5.1 line 18 personal-transfer payments as a broad remittance-flow proxy.
note: REJECTED for the alfred-fred family: no current exact Table 5.1 line 18 mirror exists; active IEAMSIRN is the broader secondary-income aggregate, while remittance-like BOPGR is broader and discontinued.
statisticalProduct: U.S. International Transactions, Table 5.1, line 18, personal-transfer payments

verification.reason: No current exact FRED/ALFRED series exists for BEA ITA Table 5.1 line 18 personal-transfer payments: IEAMSIRN is a broader aggregate and BOPGR is a broader, differently scaled discontinued predecessor.

authoritativeConceptEvidence.table: Table 5.1. U.S. International Transactions in Secondary Income
authoritativeConceptEvidence.title: Personal transfers
authoritativeConceptEvidence.periodCoverageNote: BEA directs statistics beginning in 1999 to Table 5.1 line 18.

closestSeriesEvidence.title: Secondary income (current transfer) payments
closestSeriesEvidence.mismatch: IEAMSIRN is the full secondary-income payment aggregate in ITA Table 1.2; personal transfers are only one Table 5.1 component, so the aggregate cannot resolve the requested concept.

relatedDiscontinuedSeriesEvidence.title: Private Remittances and Other Transfers (DISCONTINUED)
relatedDiscontinuedSeriesEvidence.mismatch: BOPGR ended in 2014, combines remittances with other transfers, uses billions rather than the requested millions, and cannot resolve current Table 5.1 line 18 prints.

vintageEvidence.reason: ALFRED has dated first-print vintages for IEAMSIRN, but they are vintages of the wrong aggregate; without an exact series ID, it cannot supply concept-matched first prints.
